description: Original Suno-ready songwriting and revision across all genres, with genre-specific craft guidance and a strict lyrics character checker.

defaultPrompt: Write an original Suno-ready song in my chosen genre with thoughtful lyrics and a memorable hook.
Improve these lyrics for rhythm, meaning, and natural delivery while keeping them under 5,000 characters.
Create clear Styles and Exclude Styles prompts for the sound I describe.
interface.longDescription: Write and refine original Suno-ready songs across all genres. Includes lyric and hook development, genre-specific rhythm and phrasing, advanced rap rhyme and wordplay checks, style and exclusion prompts, and a Python checker keeping the complete lyrics field below 5,000 characters. Provides writing guidance and bundled scripts; does not connect to Suno or generate audio directly.

name: atrxyns-suno-skill
